item.title: Accepted at NECsys 2025 – Hong Kong
item.description:
🎉 Our paper “Optimal Energy-sharing and Temperature Regulation in District Heating Systems” has been accepted to NECsys 2025, to be held in Hong Kong, June 2–5, 2025.

📘 Abstract

We consider the problem of temperature regulation and optimal energy sharing in district heating systems without requiring any knowledge of the demand, while ensuring satisfactory transient performance.

We show that convex optimization problems can be formulated to jointly achieve optimal temperature regulation and energy sharing. Furthermore, we demonstrate that LQR formulations can asymptotically converge to these optimal operating points—while also minimizing transient performance metrics.
